name: Registered candidate
requirement: Rule, data version and parameters frozen in the library; backtest executed and published with the trial-count lower bound.
note: Every candidate is published, including the ones that fail.

name: Eligible
requirement: G2 leakage and G3 power pass. The candidate is admissible to the competition; it has not earned anything.
note: Eligibility is not evidence of edge.

name: Forward-tested
requirement: Pre-registered in the append-only ledger before kickoff and graded against official finals on at least one untouched slate.
note: Forward grading is what separates a prediction from a fit.

name: Gate-clearing (research grade)
requirement: G2 through G8 pass while G1 (authenticated executable quotes) is still outstanding.
note: Research grade only. No money, no allocation, no recommendation.

name: Provisionally skilled
requirement: All eight gates including G1, measured on authenticated, timestamped, limit-aware prices.
reward: Named recognition on the leaderboard and a published method note
note: Recognition is not a payout and not a betting recommendation.

name: Validated and fundable
requirement: T4 plus independent prospective replication over at least two further seasons with no rule changes.
payout_status: NOT FUNDED — no authorised prize pool exists
note: Funding requires the owner to authorise a pool. Nothing is promised.

name: Disqualified
requirement: Leakage, selective reporting, fabricated quotes, or an undisclosed rule change after registration.
note: Disqualification is permanent for the strategy id.
